contents.reason: Reclassified from deferred, because the recorded reason said the transcendence proof "is scheduled far beyond this algebra page" and no transcendence page exists anywhere in plan-spec.json — a deferral with no destination is indistinguishable from a drop. The mathematics of the reason survives: squaring the circle reduces to the transcendence of pi, which is not a consequence of the quadratic-tower degree obstruction this page proves, and transcendence theory is a subject area the library has not reached and has not planned.
